description: Use when competing in a CTF pwn (binary exploitation) challenge, practicing in a lab, or testing a binary on systems you are authorized to test. Covers the full pwn workflow, checking binary protections with checksec, fuzzing input handling, exploiting stack buffer overflows to hijack control flow, writing format string exploits, building ret2libc and basic ROP chains, leaking libc addresses, and writing pwntools exploit scripts. Use when a challenge hands you a binary plus an IP and port, when you need to turn a crash into a shell, or when you must bypass NX, PIE, or stack canaries in an authorized setting.
